council_green: Calibration acceptable. Keep the setup identical and earn the increase.
The machine does not care how inspired you feel. Repeat the geometry.
council_yellow: Keep the movement precise. Reduced volume is still useful data.
Today we preserve the pattern and decline the opportunity to perform fatigue theater.
council_red: The apparatus is requesting a calibration day, not a referendum on your courage.
Reduce the load. Preserve the motion. Collect clean information.
increase_load: Repeatable output confirmed. Add five and preserve the same geometry.
Progress is permitted. Please resist celebrating by changing your setup.
hold_load: Useful result. Same load next time; make the repetitions less negotiable.
No increase. The experiment has not finished at this setting.
reduce_load: Signal quality deteriorated. Reduce five and restore the movement before adding force.
The bar path has entered fiction. Reduce the load and reacquire the pattern.
pain_stop: Pain changes the experiment. Session terminated; no diagnosis will be attempted by a cartoon laboratory.

council_green: Do the prescribed work. Then leave before enthusiasm invents another exercise.
Three sets have jobs. A fourth would need to submit an application.
council_yellow: Less work today is not less discipline. Spend fatigue where it buys adaptation.
Two useful sets are cheaper than three increasingly autobiographical ones.
council_red: Recovery is part of the program. Today the program is collecting interest.
A lighter exposure is enough. You are not paid by the rep.
increase_load: The work purchased progress. Increase the load, not the ceremony.
Five pounds. Nothing else needs to become more complicated.
hold_load: Keep the weight. The previous dose has not finished paying out.
No additional work. Repeat the prescription better.
reduce_load: You exceeded the useful price of the set. Reduce the load and restore margin.
Fatigue won the auction. Bid less next time.
pain_stop: Stopping was the productive decision. Pain is not an intensity technique.

council_green: Looks good. Move it clean and go home stronger than you arrived.
Same job as always: make heavy things behave.
council_yellow: Short shift today. Still counts if the work gets done right.
Keep something in the tank. The tank is useful tomorrow.
council_red: Easy shift. Nobody gets a medal for losing an argument with a barbell.
Move light, move clean, keep tomorrow available.
increase_load: Moved. Put five more on it next time.
Good. Now make the next plate nervous.
hold_load: Same weight next time. Make it look easier.
Bar stays where it is. You get better.
reduce_load: Back it down five. Strong includes knowing when the load is winning.
Take five off and own every rep.
pain_stop: Done for today. Keep the body; bars are replaceable.
